queries.text: "trocam os 'R' pelos 'L'" describes Portuguese baby talk; kept literally ("swap their R’s for L’s"). An English equivalent would be swapping R’s for W’s ("wabbit").
"o promíscuo 'ficar'" (Brazilian slang for casual making out or sex without commitment) → “hooking up.” "segurar o rojão" (to bear the brunt) → "hold the bag".
